workflows.content:
name: Notify release subscribers
on:
  release:
    types: [released]
permissions: {}
jobs:
  notify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Refresh verified release feed
        run: curl --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 60 -X POST https://langfuse.ufobe.com/api/public/agent-context/v1/releases/refresh

# agentq.md § 5 Release: one binary per OS and arch, SHA256SUMS, latest.json, build provenance attestations. A failing selftest publishes nothing.
# Pull requests run every step except Attest and Publish.
name: release
on:
  push:
    tags: ['v*']
  pull_request:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  build:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: macos-latest
            triple: aarch64-apple-darwin
            target: macos-aarch64
          - os: macos-15-intel
            triple: x86_64-apple-darwin
            target: macos-x86_64
          - os: windows-latest
            triple: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
            target: windows-x86_64
            ext: .exe
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            triple: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
            target: linux-x86_64
          - os: ubuntu-24.04-arm
            triple: aarch64-unknown-linux-musl
            target: linux-aarch64
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    env:
      AGENTQ_SELFTEST_OFFLINE: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - run: rustup default stable && rustup target add ${{ matrix.triple }}
      - if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y musl-tools
      - name: Version from tag
        shell: bash
        run: |
          ver=0.0.0-dev
          if [[ "$GITHUB_REF" == refs/tags/v* ]]; then
            ver="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
            perl -pi -e 'if (!$d && s/^version = ".*"/version = "'"$ver"'"/) { $d = 1 }' Cargo.toml
          fi
          grep -q "^version = \"$ver\"" Cargo.toml
          echo "VER=$ver" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - run: cargo test --target ${{ matrix.triple }}
      - run: cargo build --release --target ${{ matrix.triple }}
      - name: Selftest and stage
        shell: bash
        run: |
          bin="target/${{ matrix.triple }}/release/agentq${{ matrix.ext }}"
          "$bin" selftest
          mkdir dist
          cp "$bin" "dist/agentq-$VER-${{ matrix.target }}${{ matrix.ext }}"
      - name: Service lifecycle
        shell: bash
        run: scripts/service-lifecycle.sh "dist/agentq-$VER-${{ matrix.target }}${{ matrix.ext }}"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ${{ matrix.target }}
          path: dist/*
  describe:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: dist
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: Describe
        run: |
          ver=$(ls dist | sed -n 's/^agentq-\(.*\)-linux-x86_64$/\1/p')
          cd dist
          sha256sum agentq-* > SHA256SUMS
          python3 - "$ver" <<'PY'
          import json, os, sys
          ver = sys.argv[1]
          files = {}
          for name in sorted(os.listdir('.')):
              if name.startswith(f'agentq-{ver}-'):
                  files[name[len(f'agentq-{ver}-'):].removesuffix('.exe')] = name
          json.dump({'version': ver, 'files': files}, open('latest.json', 'w'), indent=1)
          PY
          cat latest.json SHA256SUMS
      - name: Attest
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: |
            dist/agentq-*
            dist/SHA256SUMS
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: release
          path: dist/*
  publish:
    needs: describe
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: release
          path: dist
      - name: Publish
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: gh release create "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" dist/* --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --title "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" --notes "agentq $GITHUB_REF_NAME"

name: Test
on: [push, pull_request, workflow_dispatch, merge_group]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  rust:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 15
    env:
      AGENTQ_SELFTEST_OFFLINE: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - run: rustup default stable
      - run: python tests/client_compression_check.py
      - run: python tests/provider_adapter.py
      - run: python tests/hermes_adapter.py
      - run: python tests/telemetry_qualification.py
      - run: cargo test --locked
      - run: cargo run --locked -- selftest

name: tests
on:
  push:
    branches: [main, 'taskq-*']
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
    types: [checks_requested]
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
env:
  CHECK_BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.event.before || 'HEAD^' }}
  CHECK_FULL: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}
jobs:
  plan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      scope: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.scope }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - id: plan
        run: python3 scripts/check.py --plan >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - run: git diff --check
      - run: python3 scripts/check.test.py
  rust:
    needs: plan
    if: needs.plan.outputs.scope != 'docs'
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 16
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - run: python3 scripts/check.py
  tests:
    needs: [plan, rust]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - env:
          PLAN: ${{ needs.plan.result }}
          SCOPE: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.scope }}
          RUST: ${{ needs.rust.result }}
        run: |
          test "$PLAN" = success
          case "$SCOPE" in
            docs) test "$RUST" = skipped ;;
            full) test "$RUST" = success ;;
            *) exit 1 ;;
          esac

# dashq.md D2 Release: static Linux binary per arch, SHA256SUMS, latest.json. A failing selftest publishes nothing.
# Pull requests run the same build and selftest (required checks on main); only a tag publishes.
name: release
on:
  push:
    tags: ['v*']
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
    types: [checks_requested]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  build:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
            name: linux-x86_64
          - os: ubuntu-24.04-arm
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-musl
            name: linux-aarch64
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    env:
      DASHQ_SELFTEST_OFFLINE: '1'
      TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y musl-tools
      - run: rustup update stable --no-self-update && rustup default stable && rustup target add "$TARGET"
      - name: Tag equals Cargo.toml version
        run: |
          ver="$(sed -n 's/^version = "\(.*\)"$/\1/p' Cargo.toml | head -n 1)"
          test -n "$ver"
          if [ "$GITHUB_REF_TYPE" = tag ]; then test "${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}" = "$ver"; fi
          echo "VER=$ver" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      # Tests need headless Chrome (snapshot PNG): ubuntu-latest ships it, the arm runner does not.
      # The arm artifact is still gated by its own selftest below. On a pull request tests.yml runs them.
      - if: matrix.name == 'linux-x86_64' && github.ref_type == 'tag'
        run: cargo test --locked
      - run: cargo build --locked --release --target "$TARGET"
      - name: Selftest and stage
        run: |
          bin="target/$TARGET/release/dashq"
          file "$bin" | grep -Eq 'static(ally|-pie) linked'
          "$bin" selftest
          mkdir dist
          cp "$bin" "dist/dashq-$VER-${{ matrix.name }}"
      - if: github.ref_type == 'tag'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ${{ matrix.name }}
          path: dist/*
  publish:
    if: github.ref_type == 'tag'
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: dist
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: Describe
        run: |
          ver="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
          cd dist
          sha256sum dashq-* > SHA256SUMS
          python3 - "$ver" <<'PY'
          import json, os, sys
          ver = sys.argv[1]
          files = {n[len(f'dashq-{ver}-'):]: n for n in sorted(os.listdir('.')) if n.startswith(f'dashq-{ver}-')}
          assert set(files) == {'linux-x86_64', 'linux-aarch64'}, files
          json.dump({'version': ver, 'files': files}, open('latest.json', 'w'), indent=1)
          PY
      - name: Publish
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: gh release create "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" dist/* --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --title "DashQ $GITHUB_REF_NAME" --notes "dashq $GITHUB_REF_NAME"

name: tests
on:
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
    types: [checks_requested]
  push:
    branches: [main]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - run: node tests/resources.cjs
      - name: cargo checks
        run: |
          DASHQ_FINDINGS_EVIDENCE="$RUNNER_TEMP/findings" DASHQ_RESOURCE_EVIDENCE="$RUNNER_TEMP/resources.html" DASHQ_STARTUP_EVIDENCE="$RUNNER_TEMP/startup" cargo test --locked
          cargo run -- selftest
      - name: shared resource browser chain
        run: |
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/resource-browser" playwright@1.56.1 --no-audit --no-fund
          export NODE_PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/resource-browser/node_modules"
          export PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH="$RUNNER_TEMP/resource-browsers"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/resource-browser/node_modules/.bin/playwright" install --with-deps chromium
          DASHQ_RESOURCE_EVIDENCE="$RUNNER_TEMP/resources.html" node tests/resources-browser.cjs
          DASHQ_STARTUP_EVIDENCE="$RUNNER_TEMP/startup" node tests/startup-browser.cjs
          DASHQ_FINDINGS_EVIDENCE="$RUNNER_TEMP/findings" node tests/findings-browser.cjs

name: Check
on: [push, pull_request, merge_group]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  rust:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - shell: bash
        run: rustup update stable --no-self-update && cargo test --locked

# serverq.md § 4 Release: one static Linux binary per arch, a Windows binary (§ 7), SHA256SUMS, latest.json, a build provenance attestation per binary and SHA256SUMS. A failing selftest publishes nothing.
name: release
on:
  push:
    tags: ['v*']
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  build:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            arch: x86_64
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
            name: linux-x86_64
          - os: ubuntu-24.04-arm
            arch: aarch64
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-musl
            name: linux-aarch64
          - os: windows-latest
            arch: x86_64
            target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
            name: windows-x86_64
            ext: .exe
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    env:
      SERVERQ_SELFTEST_OFFLINE: '1'
      TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y musl-tools
      - run: rustup update stable --no-self-update && rustup default stable && rustup target add "$TARGET"
      - name: Version from tag
        run: |
          ver="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
          perl -pi -e 'if (!$d && s/^version = ".*"/version = "'"$ver"'"/) { $d = 1 }' Cargo.toml
          grep -q "^version = \"$ver\"" Cargo.toml
          echo "VER=$ver" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - run: cargo test
      - run: cargo build --release --target "$TARGET"
      - name: Selftest and stage
        run: |
          bin="target/$TARGET/release/serverq${{ matrix.ext }}"
          [ "$RUNNER_OS" != Linux ] || file "$bin" | grep -Eq 'static(ally|-pie) linked'
          "$bin" selftest
          mkdir dist
          cp "$bin" "dist/serverq-$VER-${{ matrix.name }}${{ matrix.ext }}"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ${{ matrix.name }}
          path: dist/*
  attest:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: dist
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: Describe
        run: |
          ver="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
          cd dist
          sha256sum serverq-* > SHA256SUMS
          python3 - "$ver" <<'PY'
          import json, os, sys
          ver = sys.argv[1]
          files = {n[len(f'serverq-{ver}-'):].removesuffix('.exe'): n for n in sorted(os.listdir('.')) if n.startswith(f'serverq-{ver}-')}
          assert set(files) == {'linux-x86_64', 'linux-aarch64', 'windows-x86_64'}, files
          json.dump({'version': ver, 'files': files}, open('latest.json', 'w'), indent=1)
          PY
      - uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: |
            dist/serverq-*
            dist/SHA256SUMS
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: release
          path: dist/*
  publish:
    needs: attest
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: release
          path: dist
      - name: Publish
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: gh release create "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" dist/* --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --title "ServerQ $GITHUB_REF_NAME" --notes "serverq $GITHUB_REF_NAME"

name: check
on:
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
    types: [checks_requested]
  push:
    branches: [main]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - run: python3 caveman/scripts/check.py
      - run: git diff --check ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.event.before }} ${{ github.sha }}

name: Pages
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pages: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
      - name: Identify built source
        run: printf '%s\n' "$GITHUB_SHA" > docs/taskq-revision.txt
      - uses: actions/jekyll-build-pages@v1
        with:
          source: ./docs
          destination: ./_site
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: ./_site
  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pages: write
      id-token: write
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

# § 8 Release: a main push that changes the version tags v<Cargo.toml version> here (a GITHUB_TOKEN tag starts no run); one binary per OS, answer card and resource controls assets, SHA256SUMS, latest.json; release files and SHA256SUMS carry build provenance attestations. A failing selftest publishes nothing.
name: release
on:
  push:
    tags: ['v*']
    branches: [main]
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  tag:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    outputs:
      tag: ${{ steps.tag.outputs.tag }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          sparse-checkout: |
            Cargo.toml
            .github/release-tag.sh
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
      - id: tag
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          BEFORE: ${{ github.event.before }}
        run: .github/release-tag.sh >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  checks:
    needs: tag
    if: needs.tag.outputs.tag
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 16
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - name: Require selected tests on the exact source
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: python3 .github/release-check.py
  build:
    needs: [tag, checks]
    if: needs.tag.outputs.tag
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            target: linux-x86_64
          - os: macos-latest
            target: macos-aarch64
          - os: windows-latest
            target: windows-x86_64
            ext: .exe
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    env:
      TASKQ_SELFTEST_OFFLINE: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - run: rustup default stable
      - name: Static WebView2 loader for the single-file Windows release
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: rustup default stable-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
      - name: Version from tag
        if: needs.tag.outputs.tag
        shell: bash
        env:
          TAG: ${{ needs.tag.outputs.tag }}
        run: |
          ver="${TAG#v}"
          perl -pi -e 'if (!$d && s/^version = ".*"/version = "'"$ver"'"/) { $d = 1 }' Cargo.toml
          grep -q "^version = \"$ver\"" Cargo.toml
          echo "VER=$ver" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - uses: actions/cache@0057852bfaa89a56745cba8c7296529d2fc39830 # v4
        with:
          path: |
            ~/.cargo/registry
            ~/.cargo/git
            target
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-release-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}-${{ github.sha }}
          restore-keys: ${{ runner.os }}-cargo-release-${{ hashFiles('Cargo.lock') }}-
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
      - run: npm run build
      - run: cargo build --release --locked
      - name: Selftest and stage
        if: needs.tag.outputs.tag
        shell: bash
        env:
          TASKQ_INCIDENT_REPORTS: 'off'
          TASKQ_INSTALL: ${{ runner.temp }}/taskq-release-selftest
        run: |
          bin="target/release/taskq${{ matrix.ext }}"
          mkdir dist
          cp "$bin" "dist/taskq-$VER-${{ matrix.target }}${{ matrix.ext }}"
          # Start the shipped file from its isolated directory, not Cargo's build tree.
          (cd dist && "./taskq-$VER-${{ matrix.target }}${{ matrix.ext }}" selftest)
          # shared answer card assets (docs/design/answer-card.md): once, from the Linux job
          if [ "${{ matrix.target }}" = linux-x86_64 ]; then
            cp build/web/answer-card.js "dist/taskq-$VER-answer-card.js"
            cp src/answer-card.css "dist/taskq-$VER-answer-card.css"
            cp tests/fixtures/answer-card.json "dist/taskq-$VER-answer-card-fixtures.json"
            cp build/web/project-blocks.js "dist/taskq-$VER-project-blocks.js"
            cp src/project-blocks.css "dist/taskq-$VER-project-blocks.css"
            cp src/project-blocks.LICENSE "dist/taskq-$VER-project-blocks.LICENSE"
            cp tests/fixtures/project-blocks.json "dist/taskq-$VER-project-blocks-fixtures.json"
            cp docs/design/project-blocks.sources.json "dist/taskq-$VER-project-blocks-sources.json"
            cp build/web/finding-composer.js "dist/taskq-$VER-finding-composer.js"
            cp src/finding-composer.css "dist/taskq-$VER-finding-composer.css"
            cp tests/fixtures/finding-composer.json "dist/taskq-$VER-finding-composer-fixtures.json"
            cp docs/design/finding-composer.sources.json "dist/taskq-$VER-finding-composer-sources.json"
            # shared resource controls (docs/design/shared-resource-controls.md), same mechanism
            cp build/web/resource-controls.js "dist/taskq-$VER-resource-controls.js"
            cp src/resource-controls.css "dist/taskq-$VER-resource-controls.css"
            cp tests/fixtures/resource-controls.json "dist/taskq-$VER-resource-controls-fixtures.json"
          fi
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        if: needs.tag.outputs.tag
        with:
          name: ${{ matrix.target }}
          path: dist/*
  attest:
    if: needs.tag.outputs.tag
    needs: [tag, build]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          path: dist
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: Describe
        env:
          TAG: ${{ needs.tag.outputs.tag }}
        run: |
          ver="${TAG#v}"
          cd dist
          sha256sum taskq-* > SHA256SUMS
          python3 - "$ver" <<'PY'
          import json, os, sys
          ver = sys.argv[1]
          files = {}
          for name in sorted(os.listdir('.')):
              if name.startswith(f'taskq-{ver}-'):
                  files[name[len(f'taskq-{ver}-'):].removesuffix('.exe')] = name
          json.dump({'version': ver, 'files': files}, open('latest.json', 'w'), indent=1)
          PY
      # v4.2.2
      - uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8
        with:
          subject-path: |
            dist/taskq-*
            dist/SHA256SUMS
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: release
          path: dist/*
  publish:
    needs: [tag, attest]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          name: release
          path: dist
      - name: Publish
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          TAG: ${{ needs.tag.outputs.tag }}
        run: gh release create "$TAG" dist/* --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --title "$TAG" --notes "taskq $TAG"

# README shots run on dispatch or a release tag, never per tray push (taskq.md R12, Product).
name: README shots
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    tags: ['v*']
permissions:
  contents: write
  actions: write
concurrency:
  group: readme-shots-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  capture:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          # a release tag refreshes main, which the tag was cut from
          ref: ${{ github.ref_type == 'tag' && 'main' || github.ref }}
      - run: rustup default stable
      # Committed shots that are still fresh came from a Mac at 2x; the 1x runner capture must not replace them.
      - name: Check committed shots
        id: fresh
        run: if docs/shots/check.sh; then echo stale=false; else echo stale=true; fi >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Capture README shots
        shell: bash
        run: docs/shots/update.sh 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/shots.log"
      - run: docs/shots/check.sh
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: readme-shots
          path: docs/shots/
          if-no-files-found: error
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: readme-shots-log
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/shots.log
          if-no-files-found: warn
      - name: Commit and verify refreshed shots
        if: (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || github.ref_type == 'tag') && steps.fresh.outputs.stale == 'true'
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git add docs/shots/
          git diff --cached --quiet && exit 0
          git commit -m 'Refresh README screenshots' -m 'Task: https://github.com/taskqorg/taskq/issues/924'
          docs/shots/check.sh
          sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          branch="taskq-shots-$GITHUB_RUN_ID"
          git push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/$branch"
          # Token pushes do not start CI; dispatch the existing full suite on this exact bot commit.
          gh workflow run tests.yml --ref "$branch"
          for attempt in {1..12}; do
            run=$(gh run list --workflow tests.yml --branch "$branch" --event workflow_dispatch --commit "$sha" --json databaseId --jq '.[0].databaseId // empty')
            [ -n "$run" ] && break
            sleep 5
          done
          test -n "$run"
          gh run watch "$run" --exit-status
          # A concurrent main update makes this ordinary fast-forward push fail; never force it.
          git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/main
          git push origin --delete "$branch"

# § 7: PR checks and merge_group CI; publication requires green CI on the merge result.
name: tests
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ['v*']
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
    types: [checks_requested]
permissions:
  contents: read
env:
  CHECK_BASE: ${{ github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.before || 'HEAD^' }}
  CHECK_FULL: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.ref_type == 'tag' }}
jobs:
  plan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      scope: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.scope }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - id: plan
        run: python3 scripts/check.py --plan >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - run: git diff --check
      - run: python3 scripts/check.test.py
  rust:
    needs: plan
    if: needs.plan.outputs.scope != 'docs'
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 16
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - run: python3 scripts/check.py
  windows-gnu:
    needs: plan
    if: needs.plan.outputs.scope == 'full'
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 16
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: rustup toolchain install stable-x86_64-pc-windows-gnu
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
      - run: cargo +stable-x86_64-pc-windows-gnu test --locked --bin taskq platform::tests::installed_windows_release_starts_without_build_paths -- --exact --show-output
  shots:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - run: |
          rc=0; docs/shots/check.sh || rc=$?
          [ $rc = 2 ] && { echo '::warning::README shots are stale; run the README shots workflow'; exit 0; }
          exit $rc
  tests:
    needs: [plan, rust, windows-gnu, shots]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - env:
          PLAN: ${{ needs.plan.result }}
          SCOPE: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.scope }}
          RUST: ${{ needs.rust.result }}
          GNU: ${{ needs.windows-gnu.result }}
          SHOTS: ${{ needs.shots.result }}
        run: |
          test "$PLAN" = success && test "$SHOTS" = success
          case "$SCOPE" in
            docs) test "$RUST" = skipped && test "$GNU" = skipped ;;
            web) test "$RUST" = success && test "$GNU" = skipped ;;
            full) test "$RUST" = success && test "$GNU" = success ;;
            *) exit 1 ;;
          esac
